resources.title: Multi-Resource Manifest: ConfigMap + Deployment + Service + Ingress + HPA
resources.description: A single applyable YAML file for Northbridge's product-catalog service showing how five objects cross-reference each other: the Deployment's envFrom pulls from the ConfigMap, the Service's selector matches the Deployment's Pod labels, the Ingress's backend points at the Service by name, and the HPA's scaleTargetRef points at the Deployment and relies on the resource requests already declared on its containers.

resources.title: NetworkPolicy Template: Default-Deny Then Allow
resources.description: Four real NetworkPolicy objects for a PCI-scoped `payments` namespace: a default-deny-all baseline, a narrow allow rule letting only checkout reach payment-processing on 8443, a namespaceSelector rule letting monitoring scrape metrics, and an egress-restricting policy using ipBlock to stop a compromised Pod from exfiltrating data outward.

resources.title: Helm values.yaml Template for product-catalog
resources.description: A complete values.yaml matching the product-catalog chart built in Lesson 33 -- image, service, ingress, resources, autoscaling, probes, ConfigMap-equivalent config block, and a hardened securityContext (non-root, read-only root filesystem, all capabilities dropped) -- plus a documented comment block showing exactly what values-dev.yaml and values-prod.yaml typically override.
